notes.title: Zanshin v1.1 is available!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We gladly want to present the new update for Zanshin!

- New start menu
- Now you should choose a weapon before the start
- Added 5 new levels with the new graphic
- Added 6 new weapons
- Added the new type of enemies - archer 
- Added the new type of weapons - two-handed weapons
- Added quality settings in the menu
- First official game mode - arcade mode. The seamless fight against countless waves of enemies 
- Added loads of new sounds
- Added haptic feedback for hits and blocks
- Added new visual effects
- The changed balance of slow motion (Zanshin) and energy
- The changed balance of weapons and enemies
- The changed balance of dynamic difficulty
- And lots of little changes and bug fixes

We can say for sure that in this update we have remade our game from scratch.
We were not happy with the first version of Zanshin, so we have done and will do everything to improve the quality of the game as much as we can. And this is only the beginning of our journey, in the next update, we will improve the battle system, slicing system, sword physics and will add more and more content, weapons, levels, enemies and game modes.
We thank you for all your feedbacks. The next update will be soon!

notes.title: The new update will come out soon!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We glad to say that new update with a lot of crazy changes is coming out!
In firstly we want to say thanks for all your support and feedbacks on steam!
We happy to say that we made new Arcade mode instead of boring arenas where you will fight your enemies with the new awesome graphic that we will bring to you in our game in the new update!
We made new sounds, new effects, haptic feedback in controllers to get a better sword-fight experience.
And most important that we seriously improved gameplay, you will meet new types of enemies with different animations and tactics, we reworked balance in the fights and much more to get best engaging sword fights.
Here is a little showcase of upcoming graphics : )

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31734603/35148c9593290e07dd60d3b22c39ead026eaf0c3.png[/img]

Also, you can track the progress of Zanshin on my twitter!
https://twitter.com/Alexandr_Rice

Best regards,
Alexander Rice.
